## 2026-10-05

### Impact

- These changes are recommended for everyone to improve accessibility support on iOS 27. The removed APIs are unused and have long-standing replacements, so we do not expect this release to require changes in existing integrations. 

### Breaking Changes

- Removed a few public APIs that were previously deprecated:
    - Removed the old AtomicConfig init that specified a product instead of tasks
    - Removed the unused demo mode initializer

### Changes

- Improved, expanded, and fixed the DocC comments for documenting all of our public symbols in AtomicTransact. 
- Enabled static framework prelinking on our static framework artifacts. This localizes private Swift symbols before consumer linking to prevent incompatible compiler-generated symbols from being coalesced when integrating alongside other SDKs.
- Fixed an issue with Transact responding to dynamic type sizes on iOS 27. 
- Fixed an edge case in our memory cleanup that would prevent a full cleanup if transact cancelled immediately (eg, when presented with an invalid token). 

### Products

- Deposit
- Switch
- Manage

### Requirements

| Name  | Version |
| ----- | ------- |
| Xcode | >= 26.1 |
| iOS   | >= 15.0 |
